body.name: Total wedge-aware spectral certificate with balanced one-block calibration
body.construction: Check from the fixed design that every rectangle in \(\mathcal A_n\) is contained in \(\Omega_n\), that its two dimensions are at least \(r\), that the chart graph is connected under the singleton convention of Definition \ref{def:chart-graph}, that its normalized scalar gap is at least \(\gamma_{\mathrm{graph}}\) when it has more than one vertex, and that the computed chart incidence is at most \(d_{\mathrm{chart}}\). Run Definitions \ref{def:chart-graph}--\ref{def:transport-map}. The stable branch is the event that the design checks hold and \(\widehat\delta_n\ge4\tau_n\); denote its complement by \(\mathcal F_n\). On the stable branch set \[\operatorname{vec}_{W_n}(\widehat L_n)=F_n(\widetilde X_{\Omega_n})+\widehat J_n\{X_n^{(2)}-\widetilde X_{\Omega_n}\},\qquad \widehat\Sigma_n=2\sigma^2\widehat J_n\widehat J_n^{\top}\in\mathbb R^{|W_n|\times|W_n|}.\] Conditional on \(X_n^{(1)}\), \(\widehat J_n\{X_n^{(2)}-\operatorname{vec}_{\Omega_n}(L_n)\}\) is centered Gaussian with covariance \(\widehat\Sigma_n\). Let \(\mathring q_{\alpha,n}\) be the conditional \(1-\alpha/4\) quantile of \(\lVert\operatorname{mat}_{W_n}(\widehat\Sigma_n^{1/2}Z)\rVert_*\), where \(Z\sim\mathcal N(0,I_{|W_n|})\). Set \(K_n=\lceil128\alpha^{-2}\log(8n/\alpha)\rceil\) and \(\eta_n=\sqrt{\log(8n/\alpha)/(2K_n)}\). Reading \(\Zeta_n\) in coordinate order, generate \(G_k=\widehat\Sigma_n^{1/2}z_k\) with \(z_k\overset{\mathrm{iid}}{\sim}\mathcal N(0,I_{|W_n|})\). Put \(p_n=\min\{1,1-\alpha/4+\eta_n\}\), order \(T_k=\lVert\operatorname{mat}_{W_n}(G_k)\rVert_*\) by value and then simulation index, and set \(\widehat q_{\alpha,n}=T_{(\min\{K_n,\lceil K_np_n\rceil\})}\). Define \[\mathscr R_n^{(2)}=C_0r^{3/2}\tau_n^2\left(\widehat\delta_n^{-1}+\widehat M_n\widehat\delta_n^{-2}+\widehat M_n^2\widehat\delta_n^{-3}\right),\qquad \widehat R_{\alpha,n}=\widehat q_{\alpha,n}+\mathscr R_n^{(2)}.\] On \(\mathcal F_n\), set \(P_{W_n}\widehat L_n=0\), \(\mathscr R_n=s_+\sqrt{r\min\{N_n,T_n\}N_nT_n}\), and \(\widehat R_{\alpha,n}=\mathscr R_n\). The fallback radius deterministically dominates \(\lVert P_{W_n}L_n\rVert_*\). All singular values, pseudoinverses, polar factors, square roots, simulation orderings, and gauges use the total lexicographic conventions already declared, so \(\mathsf{WSVD}_n\) is measurable on every input.
